headline: Library board discussed renovation planning, budget cuts, and policy updates with no major votes taken.
summary: The board heard reports on the library renovation project, including an RFQ for a Construction Manager at Risk and upcoming Design Development work. Staffing hours have been reduced due to city budget tightening, and the Policy Committee is finishing work on an Art Exhibit and Display policy while drafting a Tabling Policy.
plain_text:
LIBRARY BOARD of COMMISSIONERS 
Wednesday, July 15, 2026, 7:45 am 
Minutes 
 
Present: Gale Batsimm, Sally Blanchard-O’Brien, Jonathan Chapple-Sokol, Emily Copeland, Mary Danko, Chol 
Dhoor, Samantha Donalds, Patrick Halladay, Cate MacLachlan, Amy Mellencamp, Nick Tatakis, Rebecca Thompson, 
Mona Tolba, Shana Trombley. 
 
Approval of minutes: from March. Patrick Halladay moved, Cate MacLachlan seconded, approved. 
 
Approval of agenda: Patrick Halladay moved, Cate MacLachlan seconded, approved. 
 
Public Forum: No public in attendance.  
 
Friends of FFL Report: Two committees are working toward planning for the future: one for book sales and one 
seeking a space to be during renovation work. 
Director’s Report: Library has an RFQ out for a Construction Manager at Risk for the future library renovation. 
Design Development is expected to begin at the end of the summer. The City budget involved tightening for all 
departments; last year FFL lost 50 hours of staffing, this year an additional 20 hours. Departments have also been 
asked to wait 30 days before posting positions, so the teen position will not be posted for a few more weeks. 
Report on Capital Campaign: The campaign is moving into Design Development. This will be a key piece of 
downtown revitalization.  
Subcommittee update: 
Policy Committee has been working on two policies. The Art Exhibit and Display policy is in final review and they 
are working on the Tabling Policy. 
New/Other Business:  
Library Summer Bingo is taking place until mid-August.  
Next meeting: September 16 at 7:45 a.m. 
Adjournment: Mona Tolba moved, Sally Blanchard-O’Brien seconded. Approved.
